advertisementContent.projectSpecificDetails:
Welcome to 1832 Fulton Street Apartments, an upscale residential experience in the vibrant Ocean Hill neighborhood in Brooklyn. This newly constructed 11-story building blends modern design with elevated comfort, offering spacious Studio, one-, and two-bedroom residences with stylish finishes and thoughtfully crafted layouts. Residents enjoy contemporary amenities, refined interiors, and convenient access to neighborhood dining, shopping, parks, and public transportation. With its sophisticated design and prime location, 1832 Fulton Street Apartments offers a comfortable and convenient place to call home in the heart of Brooklyn.

One pet allowed -30lb. weight limit per pet & some additional restrictions. No pet deposit required. Tenant is responsible for electricity with electric stove and electric heat. Hot water is included in the rent.
advertisementContent.affordableHousingProgram: This building is being constructed through the Voluntary Inclusionary Housing and the 421a Tax Exemption Program of the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
